v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_1_multipolarity_and_teaching_setti: Explicitly stated that 4+ -> 2+ (|4-2|=2 <= L <= 6) allows E2, M3, E4, M5, E6; teaching setting assumes higher multipoles M3/E4 are negligible so E2 dominates. For 4+ -> 3+ (|4-3|=1 <= L <= 7), selection rules allow M1, E2, M3; teaching setting explicitly assumes both M1 and E2 contribute (mixed transition).
v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_2_rate_constants_consistency: Consistently unified constants to Suhonen printed values (5.498e22 and 197.33 MeV fm): C_E2 = 1.2250333078e9 s^-1 MeV^-5 (e² fm⁴)^-1, C_M1 = 1.7583758801e13 s^-1 MeV^-3 [(mu_N/c)²]^-1. Deleted erroneous unrounded constant 1.22496e9 and redundant decimals. Evaluated B(E2; 4+->3+) = 275.2371 e² fm⁴ (rounded: 275.24), B(M1; 4+->3+) = 0.00545432 [(mu_N/c)²] (rounded: 0.005454), B(E2; 4+->2+) = 1042.1919 e² fm⁴ (rounded: 1042.19). Exactly harmonized with outputs/degree-dissertation/20261108-A130-rewrite/G65-parent-rate-audit.json.
v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_3_branching_terminology: Clarified distinctions between total branching b_k = lambda_k / lambda_tot, partial photon branching b_gamma,k = lambda_gamma,k / lambda_tot = b_k / (1 + alpha_k) where sum b_gamma <= 1 (strictly < 1 whenever internal conversion is present), and relative photon intensity fraction r_k = a_k / sum a_j (which reflects observed photon share but neither b_k nor b_gamma,k).
v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_4_section_ending_and_tone: Removed section 5.9.8 heading and checklist-style warnings. Substituted with a concise ~200-word transition paragraph explaining that B(XL) provides squared moduli of matrix elements and requires joint structural models (Section 5.10 and Chapter 4) to infer deformation or wobbling dynamics. Pruned assertive qualifiers throughout prose.
v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_5_timestamp_and_no_self_hash: Recorded actual UTC ISO timestamp via datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() (~2026-11-08T00:55Z). No fixed-point self-hash stored in receipt.
v3_physics_and_contract_corrections.issue_6_likelihood_vs_posterior: Clarified that profile likelihood or likelihood function exhibits double roots/multimodality and asymmetric shapes; posterior requires an explicitly declared prior. Local Gaussian symmetric error propagation risks distorting non-Gaussian multimodalities.
